item.title: Wisconsin imports down almost $2.4 billion in 2025
item.description: Wisconsin businesses imported nearly $36.4 billion in goods during 2025, a drop of $2.39 billion or about 6.2%, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau. The decline was most pronounced in the second half of the year, with a 12.3% drop in the third quarter and a 12.1% drop in the fourth quarter. Imports […]

item.title: See photos: CARW Roundtable Forum
item.description: The Commercial Association of Realtors Wisconsin recently held its annual Commercial Real Estate Roundtable Forum at the Wisconsin Club in downtown Milwaukee. During four 20-minute roundtable discussions, attendees heard from experts on a range of topics including data center development, tax changes, financing, and multifamily, retail and office market updates.
